dedupe_keys.name: viet nam technology catalogue for power generation and storage

description: The Viet Nam Technology Catalogue gives technology descriptions and data sheets for power generation and storage, as inputs for power system modelling in Viet Nam. It was developed under the Danish-Vietnamese Energy Partnership and published by Nguyen Hoang Linh, Tran Hong Viet, Stefan Petrovic and Lou Algren. The 2021 edition reviews and updates all technologies of the first 2019 edition and adds subcategories such as rooftop solar PV, floating offshore wind, low wind speed turbines, more flexible coal plants and pollution control for coal power, plus new sheets for tidal and wave power, carbon capture and storage, circulating fluidised bed coal boilers and industrial cogeneration. It covers mature and emerging technologies with projected cost and performance improvements. Coverage is Viet Nam. The catalogue is two PDFs, in English and Vietnamese, on Zenodo (updated July 2024) under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost. Caveats: data sheets are in PDF, not machine readable tables, and projections reflect 2021 assumptions. Simulation uses are technology cost and performance inputs for capacity expansion models of the Vietnamese power system. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
